recipes.baseIntent: Depict the person from the reference image as a collectible action figure in retail blister packaging, keeping their recognisable likeness, pose and expression.
immutableFeatures: recognisable facial features of the depicted person
constraints: one figure per person shown in the source
negativeConstraints: no real brand names, logos or trademarks on the packaging

parameters.name: packaging
parameters.description: Show the figure in retail packaging or standing on its own.

expectedFailureModes.description: The figure's face no longer resembles the source person.
The packaging shows garbled or invented text.
The figure has extra or missing limbs or fingers.

recipes.baseIntent: Identify the main topic shown in the reference image and present it as a radial mind map with one central node and short branch labels.
constraints: short labels in the requested language
negativeConstraints: no statements presented as verified facts
no invented statistics, sources or citations

expectedFailureModes.description: The map is about a different topic than the source image.
Branch labels contain misspelled or unreadable text.
Branches state facts that the source does not support.

recipes.baseIntent: Re-render the reference photo with the tonal, colour and grain character of 35mm analogue film without altering what the photo shows.
immutableFeatures: every person, object and text element present in the source
constraints: global tonal, colour and grain adjustment only
negativeConstraints: do not add, remove or move people or objects
do not alter faces, logos or text
do not remove scratches, stains or other visible defects

expectedFailureModes.description: Faces or objects are subtly redrawn instead of only re-toned.
People, objects or details appear that the source does not contain.
Visible scratches, stains or wear disappear.
Logos or text in the photo change or become garbled.
